title: Dinetap Admin Panel
description: Serving as the architect and tech lead for a 4-engineer team, I designed and built this full-stack administration dashboard from the ground up for Dinetap's Singapore and Australian operations. The platform provides centralized control over restaurant management, user permissions, and real-time analytics, covering the complete system from data models and API design through to the frontend.
highlights: Architected the entire system from scratch: data models, API design, and frontend architecture
Led a team of 4 engineers end-to-end from planning through to production deployment
Designed role-based access control covering all Dinetap operations and client restaurants
Built real-time analytics dashboards and customizable reporting tools

title: Dinetap Payments for Adyen
description: As tech lead for a 7-engineer team, I architected and delivered Adyen payment gateway integration across Dinetap's Singapore and Australian markets. The solution handles card, digital wallet, and physical terminal payments end-to-end, forming part of a platform now processing over SGD 13.5M per month. Built from checkout initiation through to SQS-backed webhook reconciliation.
highlights: Architected the full payment flow from checkout initiation through webhook reconciliation, leading a team of 7 engineers
Integrated Adyen physical terminal support for in-restaurant point-of-sale payments
Implemented SQS-based event queue to handle all Adyen webhook events reliably at scale
Part of a payments platform now processing over SGD 13.5M per month across Stripe, Adyen, and WooCommerce

title: Dinetap App
description: The flagship consumer app for Dinetap's global dining platforms, built under my technical leadership with a team of 6 engineers. Covers the complete dining journey from restaurant discovery and table booking through to real-time ordering and integrated payments with a cashback rewards system. Architected on React Native Expo with AWS ECS Fargate for high availability.
highlights: Architected the entire application: data models, API design, real-time infrastructure, and mobile frontend
Led a cross-functional team of 6 engineers end-to-end across all feature streams from planning through to production
Built restaurant discovery, table booking, real-time ordering, and integrated payment flows with cashback/credits system
Designed for high availability on AWS ECS Fargate with Pusher-powered real-time order updates and OneSignal push notifications

title: Dinetap BackOffice
description: Designed for restaurant owners across Dinetap's Singapore and Australian network, this operations portal was architected and led by me with a team of 5 engineers. Delivers inventory tracking, staff management, financial reporting, and performance analytics through customizable dashboards, built from database schema design through to the React frontend.
highlights: Architected the entire platform: system design, database schema, API layer, and frontend
Led a team of 5 engineers from scoping through production release
Designed a flexible dashboard system allowing restaurant owners to customize their reporting views
Built inventory, staff, and financial management modules with real-time data sync

title: Dinetap Kiosk
description: A React Native self-service kiosk application deployed across Dinetap restaurant locations in Singapore, built as part of a 5-engineer team. Optimized for large-format touchscreens with multi-language support and seamless integration with Stripe payment terminals. Engineered for unattended, always-on deployment with resilient offline error recovery.
highlights: Built the full stack end-to-end: from kiosk UI through to the backend order processing APIs
Engineered multi-language support and accessible UI optimized for large-format touchscreens
Integrated seamlessly with Stripe and Adyen payment terminals
Designed for unattended, always-on deployment with resilient error recovery

title: Dinetap POS
description: The core engineering challenge here was building a cloud-based POS that works reliably offline across multiple simultaneous devices in live restaurant environments. I led a team of 6 engineers through the full delivery for Dinetap's Singapore and Australian operations, designing the offline-first data model, multi-device sync conflict resolution strategy, and zero-downtime cloud infrastructure from the ground up.
highlights: Architected the entire POS system: offline-first data model, sync conflict resolution strategy, and cloud infrastructure
Led a team of 6 engineers through a complex offline/online synchronization challenge across multiple simultaneous devices
Designed table service workflows, order management, and real-time kitchen display integration
Built against production restaurant environments with zero-downtime deployment requirements

title: Dinetap Payments for Stripe
description: Part of the 7-engineer payments team at Dinetap, I built Stripe gateway integration spanning web, mobile, and physical terminal surfaces across the Singapore markets. Implemented SQS-backed webhook event handling, refund flows, and detailed transaction history. This work contributes to a payments platform processing over SGD 13.5M per month.
highlights: Integrated Stripe across web, mobile, and physical terminal surfaces
Built automated refund flows and detailed transaction history with reconciliation
Implemented SQS-based webhook event handling to ensure reliable payment state management
Part of a payments platform now processing over SGD 13.5M per month across Stripe, Adyen, and WooCommerce

title: Janashakthi InsureConnect
description: A mobile insurance companion app delivered for LOLC's Sri Lankan customer base as part of a 4-engineer team. Gives policyholders a single place to manage policies, submit claims, make payments, store documents, and communicate directly with agents via real-time notifications. Responsible for the full mobile application build.
highlights: Built the full mobile application as the React Native engineer
Implemented real-time push notifications and in-app agent communication
Integrated document upload, secure storage, and policy management flows
Delivered claim submission and payment processing end-to-end on mobile

title: e-Assessor
description: Built for Janashakthi in Sri Lanka, this offline-first mobile application lets insurance assessors conduct vehicle inspections in areas without connectivity. Captures photos, supports damage annotation and assessment, and automatically generates PDF inspection reports from the collected data, designed and delivered end-to-end as the sole engineer.
highlights: Built the mobile application end-to-end as the sole React Native engineer
Engineered offline-first functionality allowing assessors to work in areas without connectivity
Implemented photo capture, annotation, and damage assessment tooling
Built automated PDF report generation from inspection data

title: Dinetap Merchant App
description: Built for restaurant owners and operators across Dinetap's Singapore and Australian network, this React Native merchant app was delivered as part of a 4-engineer team. Provides real-time order management powered by Pusher, inventory tracking, and sales analytics, with integrated Stripe payment handling for in-app transactions.
highlights: Built the full stack end-to-end: mobile app, APIs, and database schema
Implemented real-time order streaming using Pusher for instant kitchen and delivery updates
Built inventory management and sales analytics modules
Integrated with the Stripe payment platform for in-app payment handling

title: ArchivEL
description: A Google Drive-style document management platform for EchonLabs in Sri Lanka, designed and led by me with a team of 6 engineers. Combines OCR-powered document indexing, version control, and workflow automation with granular access control. Tightly integrated with the BaseNeo ERP framework and the CredenEL identity platform as part of a unified enterprise product suite.
highlights: Architected the entire system: storage architecture, versioning model, workflow engine, and access control design
Led full-stack engineering from inception to production as the tech lead
Integrated OCR for automated document indexing and full-text search
Built document workflow automation and granular access control, integrated with the BaseNeo framework and CredenEL IAM system

title: Base Neo
description: Designed and built from scratch as the sole architect directing a team of 6 engineers, BaseNeo is a modular MEAN stack ERP framework that now underpins 20+ production applications across EchonLabs' Sri Lankan client portfolio. Products including ArchivEL, CredenEL, LOLC Portal, and Kelzey CMS all extend it as their foundation, inheriting its workflow engine, real-time data sync, and BI reporting layer.
highlights: Designed and built the entire ERP framework from scratch as architect and tech lead, directing a small team of engineers
Architected a modular system that other applications (ArchivEL, CredenEL, Kelzey CMS, LOLC Portal) integrate with as a foundation
The framework now underpins 20+ live production applications across EchonLabs' client portfolio
Designed customizable workflow engine, real-time data sync, and BI reporting infrastructure

title: CredenEL
description: An enterprise identity and access management platform built for EchonLabs in Sri Lanka, architected and led by me with a team of 6 engineers. Serves as the central authentication layer across the BaseNeo product suite, delivering SSO, MFA, and full RBAC-based user lifecycle management backed by a detailed audit logging system for compliance and security monitoring.
highlights: Architected the entire IAM system: authentication flows, RBAC model, SSO integration strategy, and audit logging
Led full-stack engineering as the tech lead, integrated with the BaseNeo framework
Implemented SSO, MFA, and full user lifecycle management
Designed a detailed audit logging system for compliance and security monitoring

title: Dinetap Consumer Web
description: A full-stack consumer ordering web application for Dinetap's Singapore dining platforms, built as part of a 3-engineer team. Delivers real-time order tracking via Pusher, personalized restaurant recommendations, and Stripe payment processing, all from a fast React and Vite frontend backed by a Node.js API layer.
highlights: Built the full stack end-to-end: from React frontend through to Express APIs and database
Implemented real-time order tracking using Pusher
Integrated Stripe payment processing with full order history management
Built personalized restaurant recommendation engine

title: LOLC Customer Portal
description: Led a team of 7 engineers to deliver a web portal and mobile app for LOLC's insurance customers in Sri Lanka. The mobile app achieved 20K+ downloads on the app stores. Built on the BaseNeo framework with insurance-specific modules covering policy management, claims submission, document upload, and automated renewal notifications across both web and mobile surfaces.
highlights: Led full-stack engineering as the tech lead across both web portal and mobile app
Mobile app achieved 20K+ downloads on the app stores
Built on top of the BaseNeo framework, extending it with insurance-specific modules
Implemented policy comparison, document upload, and automated renewal notification flows

title: Personalized Greeting System
description: A one-of-a-kind kiosk application built solo for live Janashakthi events in Sri Lanka. Uses real-time facial recognition to identify registered attendees and display personalized greetings on physical kiosk displays. Delivered the entire solution independently, from React Native architecture through to on-site hardware deployment.
highlights: Built the kiosk-facing React Native app as the sole engineer
Integrated real-time facial recognition to identify and greet registered attendees
Built customizable greeting template system and event analytics dashboard
Deployed on physical kiosk hardware at live Janashakthi events

title: Writer Watch (ReaderScout) Chrome Extension

Tracks sales rankings, review counts, and competitive market insights, and reached 6,000+ active users after being scoped, designed, and shipped entirely by me.
highlights: Built the entire extension as the sole developer: from Chrome extension architecture through to the backend API
Implemented real-time Amazon data scraping and parsing within extension constraints
Built sales rank tracking, review monitoring, and competitive analysis tooling
Reached 6,000+ users after delivering independently from scoping to release

title: XLife
description: Contributed as a React Native engineer to XLife, XL Axiata's employee super-app serving its Indonesian workforce, as part of a cross-functional international team of 10 spanning Sri Lanka and Indonesia. The app reached 100K+ downloads and integrates HR functions, leave management, expense tracking, and a customized Yammer-powered social feed into a single experience.
highlights: Worked as a React Native engineer within a cross-functional international team of 10 across Indonesia and Sri Lanka
App reached 100K+ downloads on the app stores
Integrated a customized Yammer platform into the app using React Native WebView
Contributed features across leave management, expense tracking, and HR modules
Conducted knowledge transfer sessions on React concepts for team members

title: WooCommerce Payments Plugin

highlights: Built the full plugin solo: from WooCommerce PHP plugin architecture through to the Dinetap payments API integration
Implemented checkout flow, payment status handling, and webhook reconciliation between WooCommerce and Dinetap
Designed for easy merchant onboarding with minimal configuration required
Tested across multiple WooCommerce versions and payment scenarios

highlights: Built the mobile application as the React Native engineer
